data.title: Hardware role: connect verified board input and office feedback
data.description: Coordinate with the existing hardware work; inventory actual modules/ports and normalize a confirmed button or calibrated stock-low transition into DeviceEvent. Done: physical input reaches API, custom office_feedback reaches verified display/LED hardware, event retry IDs remain stable, calibration/debounce and tested vs unverified paths are documented. Run device tests. Do not duplicate device-serial-framing.

data.title: Agent/speech role: integrate STT transcript with validated interpretation
data.description: Build on existing stt task rather than replacing it. Done: use its published signature to submit transcript with the selected station through the existing API, handle clarification/maintenance/purchase, preserve typed fallback, and publish any changed cross-owner interface first. Verify mock flow and relevant tests; verify live Claude only with configured credentials and label its actual validation status.

data.title: Procurement role: verify catalogue, spending and simulated execution handoff
data.description: Existing planning/mock supplier already exist; inspect and reuse them. Done: approved station-scoped product produces exact NOK snapshot and tracked SIM reference; demonstrate spend-limit clarification, stale approval rejection, duplicate event/purchase protection and failed-execution handling with meaningful existing tests. Record any gaps on this task. Keep execution simulated; real supplier enablement is outside this task.

data.title: Dashboard/integration role: verify complete demo and recovery behavior
data.description: One integration owner to claim; existing UI/API are the baseline. Done: demonstrate input → proposal → exact approval → simulated confirmation and maintenance → resolution, visible simulation labels, SSE/poll recovery from authoritative API, and device command changes. Run npm run check, npm run build and npm test for touched boundaries; document mock/live/hardware paths actually exercised. Coordinate component handoffs without taking over their tasks.
